source.source_boundary: CMLocation.CMT is nonnegative calendar turnaround in hours. The accepted D06 parent maps FM-POS-A to direct system CM with CMT=0.5 and OPHOURS failure exposure. This child extends CMT without changing the failure mode, mission schedule, seed or 36-hour horizon.

delta.mechanism: Change FM-POS-A direct system CM CMT 0.5 to 15.5 hours, crossing the scheduled hour-20 mission after an anticipated first-mission failure; description label also changes.

predeclared_native_acceptance: The guarded session-0 SSH runner uses the host-wide native mutex and GUI PID 13340 identity guard and seals all source and raw bytes; import, export, calculation, report and row-containing source roundtrip complete with zero conversion errors.

The fixed seed produces an FM-POS-A critical failure during the first mission. Native events show direct system CM starting after return and still active at the scheduled hour-20 mission boundary, then show its eventual completion or explicit horizon limitation.

The hour-20 mission's actual creation, allocation, delay, cancellation and/or success is determined from native events and reconciled with aligned report bins, without assuming a queue rule from the input alone.
The exact parent delta changes only CMLocation.CMT and description. Differences in later failure draws and mission outcomes are measured, not assumed equal to the half-hour D06 parent.
An independent reviewer replays parent diff, source and raw seals, guarded invocation, event timeline, report metrics and limits before publication.
limits: One explicit FMID, one fixed seed and one long direct system CM; no alternative position, replacement, personnel capacity, GUI visual content or cross-engine equivalence.
CMT is calendar turnaround, not a measured labor occupancy. This case may overlap the scheduled mission without proving a general repair priority or rescheduling algorithm.
